subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: What synthetic message contract should Feishu card actions use when callback fields outside `action.value` are present?
rationale: The code fix is small, but the exact JSON-versus-command text format becomes user-visible agent input and may affect existing cards that expect plain command extraction.

options.title: Structured only for interactive fields
options.body: Preserve the existing plain-button extraction path and emit a structured JSON payload only when `form_value`, `input_value`, `option`, or `options` is present.

options.title: Command-style append format
options.body: Append form/select values to the command text as tokens, which may be easier for command parsers but can be ambiguous for arbitrary user input.

options.title: Defer the field pass-through
options.body: Keep current behavior until a broader Feishu interactive-card contract is designed, accepting continued data loss for forms/selects in the meantime.

recommendation.title: Structured only for interactive fields
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing plain-button extraction path and emit a structured JSON payload only when `form_value`, `input_value`, `option`, or `options` is present.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu card-action fixes and refactors make this the best available routing candidate for the payload-contract decision.
